questions.question: Basic manual dew point measurement devices are commonly used by surveyors when monitoring the dryness of a cargo tank prior to loading a liquid chemical product. Which of the descriptions below is a summary of how the measurement is carried out?
options: A quantity of Acetone is placed into the device and dry-ice is progressively added to it to steadily reduce the temperature. A sample of the atmosphere in the tank is continuously pumped through the liquid. Bubbles will be seen to reach the surface of the bath until the dew point is reached. When the flow of bubbles ceases, the temperature of the Acetone is noted. Reference may be required to tables to correct the reading for desired parameters.

A small quantity of dry-ice is placed into the device, submerged in deionized water. A sample of the atmosphere in the tank is continuously drawn through the device, passing across a reagent filter. When the dew point is reached, this reagent filter will change colour from white to green, indicating saturation. The temperature of the deionized water is noted at this time and corresponds to the dew point. Reference to correction tables is required to correct the reading for barometric pressure.

A small quantity of Acetone is placed into the device and dry-ice is progressively added to it to steadily reduce the temperature. A sample of the atmosphere in the tank is continuously drawn through the device, passing over the polished or mirrored surface of the container. When the first drop of mositure (dew) is observed to form on the polished surface, the temperature of the Acetone bath is noted. Reference may be required to tables to correct the reading for desired parameters.

A small quantity of Methanol is placed into the device and dry-ice is progressively added to it to steadily reduce the temperature. A sample of the atmosphere in the tank is continuously drawn through the device, passing over the surface of the Methanol. When the first signs of evaporation are observed (smoke rising from the surface), the temperature of the Methanol is noted. Reference may be required to tables to correct the reading for calculation purposes.

In different compartments or holds when stowed "under deck". Provided an intervening deck is resistant to fire and liquid, a vertical separation may be accepted as equivalent. For "on deck" stowage, this segregation means a distance of at least 6 metres.

questions.question: A casualty suddenly loses consciousness and falls to the ground letting out a strange cry. The patient is red-blue in the face and froth may appear around the mouth. You are witnessing a major epileptic attack. What should you do?
options: Forcibly restrain and try to wake the casualty.
Give the casualty a lot to drink and keep talking to the person at all times.
Move the casualty in a sit-up position and put something in the persons mouth to protect the tongue.
Loose tight clothing, ask all unnecessary bystanders to leave and carefully place something soft under the head. If casualty is unconscious, place the person in Recovery position.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the "Bowsing tackle" (block and tackle) supplied at each end of the lifeboat?

It enables the boat to be secured to the embarkation deck so that the wire falls can be released for changing or end for ending
It is a general purpose tackle to be used in any type of emergency
It is designed to pull the boat alongside the embarkation deck after the tricing pennants have been released

questions.question: When having a fire alarm during normal working hours, what immediate actions should be taken?

Act according to instruction given in the muster list.
Start the fire pump, the sooner the better.
Everybody gather in the safety centre.

questions.question: As regards the launching and recovery arrangements for rescue boats which is required among the following?
options: Means shall be available to prevent any discharge of water on to survival craft during abandonment
Different type of launching and recovery arrangements shall be used for similar survival craft on board the ship
Launching and recovery arrangements shall be such that they can be operated at all times from the bridge
Each lifeboat shall be provided with separate appliances which is capable of launching and recovering the lifeboat

questions.question: In ship's stability what is understood by the term "In stable equilibrium"?
options: The term "stable equilibrium" means that the vessel complies fully with the International Loadline Rules
The term "stable equilibrium" means when the cargo loaded in each hold is the maximum that hold can carry
Stable equilibrium exists when the vessel returns with G below M after an external heeling force is removed
Stable equilibrium means the vessel is floating upright and has zero GM

questions.question: The passage of electrical current through the body may result in severe and sometimes fatal injuries. Just take the causalty in your arms and pull the person away.
Apply fish oil on your hands and cut the cords by the use of any metallic pliers.
Call the electrician immediately.
